name: Aapki Ventures Inc.
summary: AAPKI Ventures Inc. does not have significant operations. The company intends to acquire new business opportunities. Previously, it was engaged in the acquisition and exploration of mineral property business. The company was formerly known as Pushfor Tech Inc. and changed its name to AAPKI Ventures Inc. in November 2023. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Surrey, Canada.
